label: Thirteen-slot profile schema: targeted admissibility and same-bearer GOD_4 naming (#1864)
summary: Follow-on to merged #1865, in the Lean module TruthCore/Modal/DivineProfile.lean (moved out of ActualistDomains in repair pass 1). ProfileSlots is a 13-slot world-indexed predicate schema with NO sense fixed: every theorem quantifies over an arbitrary schema and holds with every slot True (Control.noSenseFixed); the slots are not StageTwo's typed senses nor NamingVeracityBatch1.Power, because those are world-invariant and IsTheOneGod/GodIsOmnipotent use sigma.IsGod, which must stay out of possible-world premises. ExcellenceAt asks all thirteen slots of one bearer at one world; GreatnessAt reuses #1865's MaximalProfile over M = m.frame. Proved (zero axioms): described_greatness_transfer, a near-transcription (one application of the profile-specific AdmitGreatnessWorlds; singleton case of #438 TransferLaws); greatness_at_origin from EuclideanAt and ActualReflexive at w only (same algorithm as ActualEuclidean.necessaryAtOrigin; new content is the excellence conjunct), factored through the witness-relative condition M(v,w) and M(w,u) -> M(v,u), which needs no reflexivity; describedInnerE_to_outerE with the extra InnerSuccessorsCovered bridge, since DescribedPossibleGreatness is outer-E/inner-M and therefore not purely descriptive; profileNineSuffice_of_senseBridges, deriving the distinct analyst bridge ProfileNineSuffice (not STMT-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-SUFFICE) from the canonical typed StageTwo instance plus explicit actual-world sense bridges ProfileToStageTwoSenses, with a one slot meant to be GOD-free (an instantiation rule the type does not enforce; a registration must check that no slot mentions IsGod) bridged to IsTheOneGod only at w; actual_named_classical_god/actual_god_exists from these plus the OPEN ActualDivineNaming; actual_necessary_bundle_greatness, showing that an actual excellent bearer plus NecessaryExcellenceAt (necessary existence and excellence, not essentiality) already gives the actual maximal profile with no frame condition, so the possibility detour adds no independent support. Finite controls: E-witness without M-witness; targeted admissibility without global inclusion; separately instantiated power/knowledge without joint bearer; K5 Euclidean without actual existence (Euclidean alone insufficient); Euclidean-at-w without reflexivity still returning the profile (reflexivity not necessary); inner-E without outer-E; slot separations (good without morallyPerfect, intellect without omniscient, will without free); naming omission (every other premise of actual_god_exists true, IsGod empty, GodExists false). Positive warrant: the actual same-root/esse/perfection/intellect-will corpus bears on the actual-bearer input once slots receive fixed senses; it does not yet give power, full knowledge, moral perfection or freedom in any fixed sense. Best supported incompatibility pressure remains #555's necessary strict-efficacy same-act with a contingent effect, applicable only under a definite simplicity/freedom reading. No canonical argument/result registered; no root premise change. Continuation (2026-11-23): a fixed GOD-free instance now reuses StageTwo IsSimple/IsPerfect/IsSupremelyGood/IsImmutable, selected-root uniqueness, existing capacity Intellect/Will, DeiFiliusAttributeField.IsAlmighty, and explicit world-indexed content-knowledge/permitted-selection/noncoerced-choice candidate senses. positiveCore_from_same_root reuses NecessaryPositiveRootIntellectWillAt for one witness with necessity and six typed attributes (conditional on its full original inputs). fixed_to_stageTwo_senses derives eight pointwise slot bridges and isolates the ninth as open actual-world selected-root-to-IsTheOneGod naming. Two formal intersection discriminators: factive complete knowledge plus rigidly invariant known-content extension precludes contingent truth across worlds; power for a coherent forbidden task and impeccability of actual selection jointly entail capability without selection, not contradiction. All are Lean-only proposed results pending final-head CI and independent semantic challenge; no metaphysical possibility or GOD_4 bridge established. Follow-on same-witness positive extension: positiveCore_with_infinite_power_from_same_root applies existing SubsistentBeingIsInfiniteReading to the n with esse=essence in NecessaryPositiveRootIntellectWillAt, then reuses registered infinitePowerFromAct under OPEN InfiniteIsUnlimitedAct, ActivePowerFollowsAct and ConsistentTaskRequiresOnlyPossiblePerfections. This reaches eight fixed candidate slots (adding infinite and omnipotent capacity) on the same necessary actual source without introducing IsGod or altering the source premises; no actual creation or cognition follows.
blocker: Still OPEN: (1) independently check and challenge the proposed fixed-profile Lean, including same-witness theorem and the two attribute intersections; (2) actual-world M-as-metaphysical interpretation and the specific full-profile realization (outer-E/inner-M versus inner-E); (3) full-coverage factive cognition versus merely accurate information, intrinsic intentional exercise; (4) genuinely maximal moral goodness, uncoerced versus libertarian/timeless freedom, essential capacity versus contingent selection; (5) positive same-root warrant for the seven not included slots and necessary excellence across alternatives; (6) actual-world selected-root uniqueness -> IsTheOneGod, real naming and canonical classical-field bridge, DEF/sense records, and actualist/counterpart identity premise. #555 same necessary act/strict efficacy/contingent output remains the principal philosophical compatibility test. No bound corpus result or root-premise change claimed.

current_assessment.assessment: Provisional, unreviewed extension of merged #1876: interpreted same-bearer profile now reuses eight existing typed StageTwo senses and typed IsAlmighty, but cognitive/moral/freedom fields are explicitly restricted analyst senses. Under the existing NecessaryPositiveRootIntellectWillAt premises, one necessary actual bearer has simple, perfect, causally good, uniquely selected-root, intellectual-capacity and will-capacity slots. Conditional incompatibility: invariant factive complete known-content sets conflict with contingent content truth; this invariant-extension premise has NOT been derived from simplicity. Conditional compatibility: omnipotent coherent-task power differs from actually electing a morally impermissible task. The full traditional attribute profile's metaphysical joint possibility, access, necessity, and GOD_4 naming remain open. No new bound result; proof validity is pending CI, so these are proposed theorems, not yet certified. Additional conditional same-witness derivation through existing Aquinas q.7 and registered q.25 power route reaches eight selected fixed slots once the four extra substantive infinity/power principles are supplied; the five other slots, their essential necessity and metaphysical possibility remain open.
